quests.instruction: What color is the chalk a teacher uses on a blackboard?
quests.explanation: Chalk is usually white because it shows up well on a dark board.
quests.funFact: Chalk is often made from a soft rock, like limestone.

quests.instruction: Which one is usually brown?
quests.hint: Think of the ground after the rain stops.
quests.explanation: Mud is brown because it is soil mixed with water.
quests.funFact: Mud bricks have been used to build houses for thousands of years.

quests.instruction: Cherries often grow in pairs. What color are ripe cherries?
quests.explanation: Ripe cherries are red, and the color tells us they are ready to pick.
quests.funFact: Cherry blossoms in spring are usually pink or white.

quests.instruction: Corn on the cob is sweet and crunchy. What color are the kernels?
quests.explanation: Sweet corn kernels are yellow, like the sun.
quests.funFact: Corn kernels grow in neat rows, and each row has an even number.

quests.instruction: Which one is usually white?
quests.hint: Remember a cloud or a sheet of paper.
quests.explanation: The shell of many eggs is white, though some are brown.
quests.funFact: A chicken's earlobe color can hint at the egg color she lays.

quests.instruction: Which crayon would you use to color the ocean on your map?
quests.explanation: Maps often show water in blue, just like the sea looks on a sunny day.
quests.funFact: About three out of every four parts of Earth's surface are covered by water.

quests.instruction: A basketball is bouncing on the court. What color is it?
quests.explanation: Most basketballs are orange so players can spot them easily.
quests.funFact: A basketball hoop is ten feet above the floor.

quests.instruction: Which one is usually green?
quests.hint: Imagine a pea in a pod.
quests.explanation: Cucumbers have green skin that helps them hide in leafy vines.
quests.funFact: Cucumbers are about ninety-five percent water.

quests.instruction: What color is a bowl of cooked rice?
quests.explanation: Plain cooked rice is white, and it looks fluffy in the bowl.
quests.funFact: Rice is a food for billions of people around the world.

quests.instruction: A traffic light says "go" when it shows which color?
quests.hint: Think of a leaf on a tree.
quests.explanation: Many traffic lights show green when it is safe to go.
quests.funFact: The colors on a traffic light are placed in the same order almost everywhere.

quests.instruction: Which one is usually gray?
quests.explanation: Many house mice are gray, so they blend into dark corners.
quests.funFact: A mouse's whiskers help it feel things around it in the dark.

quests.instruction: What color is a bright rose in a garden bouquet?
quests.hint: It may remind you of a love letter.
quests.explanation: Roses come in many colors, and red is the one many people picture first.
quests.funFact: A rose's thorns are there to protect the plant.

quests.instruction: Sapphires are precious stones. Which color is a classic sapphire?
quests.explanation: A sapphire is usually deep blue, and it shines like water.
quests.funFact: Sapphires also come in pink and yellow.

quests.instruction: You are coloring a pig, a bubblegum bubble and a flamingo. Which crayon do you need?
quests.hint: They are all a light shade of red.
quests.explanation: All three are pink, so one crayon works for the set.
quests.funFact: Pink is made by mixing red with white.

quests.instruction: What color is soil in a flower pot?
quests.explanation: Rich soil is brown, which helps plants find food.
quests.funFact: A handful of healthy soil can have more tiny living things than there are people.

quests.instruction: Honey is a sweet food made by bees. What color is it?
quests.explanation: Honey is a golden color, a deep, shiny yellow.
quests.funFact: A bee visits many flowers to make a small spoonful of honey.

quests.instruction: Which one is usually purple?
quests.explanation: Some plums are deep purple, a mix of red and blue.
quests.funFact: A dried plum is called a prune.

quests.instruction: Which one is usually black?
quests.hint: It may remind you of the night sky.
quests.explanation: Crows have dark feathers that look black.
quests.funFact: Crows can remember human faces.

quests.instruction: A baby chick is fluffy and small. What color is it?
quests.hint: It may remind you of the sun in a drawing.
quests.explanation: Many baby chicks are yellow and fluffy.
quests.funFact: A chick starts to peep before it even hatches.

quests.instruction: Raspberry jam is spread on warm toast. What color is the jam?
quests.explanation: Raspberries are red, and jam made from them keeps that color.
quests.funFact: Raspberries can also be black or yellow.

quests.instruction: What color is a coconut shell outside?
quests.explanation: The hard outside of a coconut is brown and hairy.
quests.funFact: A coconut tree can grow near the beach.

quests.instruction: Which one is usually orange?
quests.explanation: A common goldfish is orange, like a ripe pumpkin.
quests.funFact: Goldfish can live for many years if they are well cared for.

quests.instruction: What color is a rain cloud before a storm?
quests.explanation: A heavy rain cloud looks gray because it is thick and blocks sunlight.
quests.funFact: Tiny water drops in a cloud join to make raindrops.

quests.instruction: What color is butter?
quests.explanation: Butter is yellow, like corn on the cob.
quests.funFact: Butter is made by shaking cream until it turns solid.

quests.instruction: A tire swing hangs in the playground. What color is the rubber tire?
quests.explanation: Most tires are black, even on a swing.
quests.funFact: Rubber trees give a milky juice that is used to make rubber.

quests.instruction: Lettuce leaves are tucked inside a sandwich. What color is fresh lettuce?
quests.hint: Look at what grows in a vegetable garden.
quests.explanation: Fresh lettuce is green, though some kinds are red or purple.
quests.funFact: Lettuce is mostly water, which is why it feels crisp.

quests.instruction: A squirrel carries an acorn up a tree. What color is a ripe acorn?
quests.hint: Look at what covers the ground under an oak tree in autumn.
quests.explanation: A ripe acorn is brown, like many nuts.
quests.funFact: Acorns are the seeds of oak trees.

quests.instruction: What color are fire engines in most picture books?
quests.explanation: Fire engines are often painted red so people notice them quickly.
quests.funFact: In some places fire engines are painted yellow or green instead.

quests.instruction: What color is a sheep's wool before anyone dyes it?
quests.hint: It is as fluffy as a cloud.
quests.explanation: Sheep wool is often white, so it can be dyed any color.
quests.funFact: Some sheep have black or brown wool.

quests.instruction: A lime is a small, sour citrus fruit. What color is its skin?
quests.hint: It is not the color of a lemon.
quests.explanation: A lime has green skin, a bit like a leaf.
quests.funFact: Limes are added to drinks to give them a sharp taste.
